assets.name: dragon
assets.prompt:
Create NEW production-oriented sprite concept art for the snowy ski game Frostline. Attached image is STYLE/SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its crisp tiny low-resolution PC-game pixel language, muted blue-violet shadows, dark slate outlines, off-white snow and warm restrained accents. Do not copy any of its characters.
Subject: one charming chunky SNOW DRAGON with a broad flat snow-dusted back that a tiny skier could ride, a long curling tail, short swept horns, small batlike wings, friendly mischievous expressive face and clearly articulated paws. Stocky readable silhouette, pale blue/slate scales, cream snowy back, muted mauve wing membranes, tiny warm amber eyes. Cute and magical, not a flying lizard stick figure. View from above/front in the SAME 3/4 downhill game view as reference. The body/back must read as a rideable horizontal platform; keep face visible.
Deliver exactly FOUR separate consistent full-body poses in a precise 2x2 sprite sheet, square canvas, four equal cells, generous transparent gutters, each complete creature fits inside its own cell, same character proportions and scale. Top-left low glide wings fully raised, top-right bank left with wings angled/body curving, bottom-left bank right with opposing wing/body curve, bottom-right committed downward dive with wings folded and tail raised. Same color/design across frames. No character other than the dragon. Designed to survive reduction to approximately 64x48 actual logical pixels per frame, rendered with hard square pixel clusters and compact palette. Deliberate large pixel clusters, rich silhouette and thoughtful pixel shading; no smooth painted curves, no blur, no antialias, no HD illustration, no gradient glow. Actual transparent alpha background; no checkerboard, text, labels, grid lines, floor or cast shadow. This is a new sprite sheet, not an edit of the reference atlas.

assets.name: mountain
assets.prompt:
Create NEW production-oriented sprite concept art for the snowy ski game Frostline. Attached image is STYLE/SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: match crisp tiny low-resolution PC-game pixel clusters, muted blue-violet shadows, dark slate outlines, off-white snow, rich organic silhouettes. Subject: an adorable ancient MOUNTAIN SPIRIT embodied as a squat chunky STONE RAM / IBEX: an actual full quadruped animal body, curled carved rock horns, rounded layered slate-stone flanks, short stout hooves, snow piled over its back like a miniature alpine hill, a little dark evergreen moss beard, warm amber eyes, small expressive stone muzzle. Clearly an animal, not a rectangular floating face, humanoid golem or mountain with eyes. Its body can curl into a rolling boulder with its carved horns visible on the sides. Muted slate blue, desaturated earthy grey, cream snow, tiny warm amber accents; cute slightly grumpy magical guardian. Seen from above/front in the reference game's 3/4 view.
Deliver exactly FOUR full consistent poses on one square sprite sheet, precise 2x2 equal cells with generous transparent gutters. Top-left curled asleep with head resting on forehooves; top-right awake and uncurling on four legs; bottom-left fully curled rolling-boulder pose, horns flank the compact round body and snow sheds from rim; bottom-right braking with forehooves planted, body leaned back, alert expression. All frames same scale and identity, no creature crop or cell overlap. Must read beautifully at approximately 64x56 logical game pixels per frame. Crisp coarse square pixel clusters with carefully shaded organic forms, limited palette. No smooth illustration, gradients, blur or HD tiny detail. Actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, labels, text, borders, floor or cast shadows. New sprite sheet only; never alter the supplied reference atlas.

assets.name: kitsune
assets.prompt:
Create NEW production-oriented sprite concept art for Frostline, a snowy pixel-art ski game. Attached image is STYLE/SCALE REFERENCE ONLY for coarse tiny logical pixels, muted palette, organic character silhouettes, dark slate outlines, snowy off-white highlights and blue-violet shade. Do not edit or reproduce the atlas.
Subject: a cute mischievous WINTER KITSUNE, a clearly recognizable little fox with triangular ears, pointed muzzle, compact running quadruped body and FIVE luxuriant fox tails spreading in a readable fan behind it. Cream-white fur, pale lavender/grey shaded underside and tail roots, charcoal paws and ear rims, warm amber eyes, subtle muted russet cheek marks. It must look like a fox, not a rabbit, cat, or white caterpillar. Expressive but at the tiny in-game scale, designed to read at 32x28 logical pixels. No clothing, collar, crown or giveaway mark identifying a real one from an illusion.
Exactly FOUR consistent full-body poses in a 2x2 square sprite sheet with equal cells and generous transparent gutters. Top-left running stride with forelegs reaching, top-right opposing running stride with body compressed/paws gathered, bottom-left graceful turning/banking pose with tail fan swinging sideways, bottom-right playful brief split gesture with tails flaring and a small localized puff of pixel leaf-smoke behind the tails. Each cell contains ONE fox only, same identity/proportions/scale, every tail and paw fits within its cell. Above/front 3/4 game view. Genuine low-resolution coarse pixel clusters, compact palette, carefully shaded readable fluffy tails, no smooth vector curves, blur, antialiasing, painted detail, gradients or neon glow. Actual transparent alpha background. No ground, cast shadow, text, labels, grid lines, checkerboard or extra foxes. New sheet only, reference remains unchanged.
